title: User arrival and auth surfaces: landing, sign-in, sign-out, expiry, recovery, onboarding, and deep-link redirects
description: The application ships designed surfaces for: first-visit unauthenticated landing, sign-in, sign-out confirmation, session-expired, forgot-password, account-recovery, and first-run onboarding. Deep-link and post-authentication return-to behaviour is owned on TAC-201-application-spa-app-shell.responsibilities[5].
rationale: Arrival and auth surfaces are the first and the worst-tested screens in most applications. Specifying them as first-class surfaces stops them shipping as afterthoughts.
